assertions.text: Output contains at least 2 separate markdown tables (not everything crammed into one table)
assertions.evidence: Response contains Table 1: Trial Lifecycle, Table 2: Cancellation Refund Eligibility, Table 3: Prorated Refund Amount, and a fourth summary table of open questions — four distinct markdown tables.

assertions.text: The tables cover distinct concerns — e.g. pricing/plans is separate from cancellation/refund rules
assertions.evidence: Table 1 covers trial lifecycle (when trials expire, what status changes occur), Table 2 covers cancellation refund eligibility (24-hour rule application), Table 3 covers prorated refund amount calculation — three distinct concerns that are separated into different tables.

assertions.text: At least one output column in each table ends with '?'
assertions.evidence: Table 1 has 'Status After?' and 'Charge?'; Table 2 has 'Refund Eligible?' and 'Reason?'; Table 3 has 'Refund Amount?' — all output columns end with '?'.

assertions.text: The 24-hour no-refund exception is included as a distinct scenario row
assertions.evidence: Table 2 includes multiple rows explicitly covering the 24-hour no-refund window: 'Cancel monthly, 12h after renewal' with 'no | Within 24h window', 'Cancel annual, 6h after renewal' with 'no | Within 24h window', and 'Cancel at exactly 24h after renewal' marked with open boundary question.

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language — no implementation terms like 'boolean', 'int', 'isProrated', camelCase identifiers
assertions.evidence: All column names across the three tables use plain business language: 'Scenario', 'Days Since Sign-up', 'Trial Length (Policy)', 'Status After?', 'Charge?', 'Subscription Status', 'Hours Since Last Charge', 'Refund Eligible?', 'Reason?', 'Plan', 'Charge', 'Days in Cycle', 'Days Remaining', 'Refund Amount?' — no technical identifiers or camelCase terms.

assertions.text: Includes a row or scenario for cancelling during the free trial — no charge was made, so no refund applies. This case should be explicit, not omitted.
assertions.evidence: Table 2, first data row: 'Cancel during trial | Trial | N/A — nothing charged | no | Nothing charged yet' explicitly covers the trial cancellation scenario with the reasoning.

assertions.text: The prorated refund calculation is shown or explained — e.g. days remaining × daily rate, or an equivalent formula. Not just 'prorated refund' without showing how.
assertions.evidence: Table 3 demonstrates the formula through concrete examples: 'Monthly, 10 days left' shows £9.99 × 10/30 = £3.33, and the open questions section explicitly states '£9.99 × 15/30 = £4.995' showing the formula is (Charge / Days in Cycle) × Days Remaining.

assertions.text: The 24-hour no-refund window is tested near the boundary (e.g. values at or close to 23h, 24h, 25h) — not just 'within 24h' vs 'well after renewal'.
assertions.evidence: Table 2 tests only 6h, 12h, and exactly 24h after renewal. While it marks 24h with an open question 'Is boundary inclusive?', it lacks tight boundary testing as exemplified by 23h and 25h values. The 12h value is halfway to the boundary, not 'close to' in the sense of the 1-hour examples (23h, 25h), and there is no value just beyond the boundary (25h+) to disambiguate the boundary behavior, leaving the question still open.

assertions.text: Refund eligibility (yes/no, based on 24h rule and trial status) and refund amount (prorated calculation) are in separate tables — not mixed into one table. This separation makes each concern independently reviewable.
assertions.evidence: Table 2 is dedicated to 'Cancellation Refund Eligibility' with column 'Refund Eligible?'; Table 3 is dedicated to 'Prorated Refund Amount' with column 'Refund Amount?' — the two concerns are in separate tables and are not mixed.

assertions.text: The '?' suffix is only used on output/expected columns (e.g. 'Refund Eligible?', 'Refund Amount?') — not on input columns like plan type, loyalty status, or yes/no flags. Input columns should not have '?' suffixes.
assertions.evidence: Input columns across all tables ('Scenario', 'Days Since Sign-up', 'Trial Length (Policy)', 'Subscription Status', 'Hours Since Last Charge', 'Plan', 'Charge', 'Days in Cycle', 'Days Remaining') have no '?' suffix. The '?' suffix appears only on output/expected columns: 'Status After?', 'Charge?', 'Refund Eligible?', 'Reason?', 'Refund Amount?'.
